propertyDetails.description: Tucked along a quiet, tree-lined street in a central Campbell location, this beautifully updated single-story home offers move-in-ready comfort with exciting future potential. Served by award-winning Capri Elementary, Rolling Hills Middle, and Westmont High, the home also features owned Tesla solar and approved permits for a 4th bedroom addition, delivering a rare blend of efficiency and flexibility. The remodeled kitchen is a standout with new cabinetry, quartz counters, tile backsplash, LVP flooring, and new appliances, creating a polished space for everyday living and entertaining. Gleaming hardwood floors run throughout, while remodeled bathrooms add a polished finish. A permitted sunroom expands the living space and features new flooring installed in 2026, offering a versatile area ideal for a home office, gym, playroom, or relaxed lounge with a natural connection to the backyard. Outside, enjoy a peaceful setting for lounging and gatherings, with an attached 2-car garage. Additional highlights include a roof replaced in 2013, 220V outlet for EV charging, designer light fixtures, recessed LED lighting, full interior and exterior paint, & refreshed landscaping. Minutes from Downtown Campbell (~1 mi), with easy access to Lawrence and San Tomas Expressways and Hwy 85/880/280.
